hints.description: From Fondotoce along the steep staircase of the old cemetery and then on the track and then the path You reach the paved mule-track that goes up to Cavandone

places.name: P07a - Cappella Or Vergugn - Ponte Velina

hints.description: From the Or Vegugn Chapel, on the path P07, to Velina Bridge, to the cross with P50 path along the river, through Alpe Bettina. You enter the wild Valgrande following the old path used to load the Velina Alps starting from Rovegro

Da S. Libera si effettua un percorso ad anello che con un ardito ponticello e con la mitica Scala Santa supera il rittano del rio Chiappea e raggiunge la solitaria Chiesetta di S. Bovo, da cui si gode un stupendo panorama sulla valle Belbo

The mountaineers came in the lower Valgrande along two lines that from Rovegro to Or Vergugn were common then one continued for Velina, Futt Bridge, Orfalecchio to Rodugno, ours for Scellina as far as Corte Buè, besides it was dangerous

A daring and challenging route that runs along the steep side of the Rio Valgrande with frequent dripping tunnels where an open-air water conduit flows, dilapidated small bridge and a Tibetan Bridge are the final highlight.

places.name: P50b - Orfalecchio - Val Foiera - Corte Buè

hints.description: Alternative route to leave or reach the Ferrata Selvaggio Verde with views over the entire Valgrande. It runs for a stretch along the line of the old cableway for timber of which the pylons remain

A short itinerary from Rovegro to the Chapel of Erfo which connects two paths of great interest: the P00 that from Verbania allows access to the Valgrande / ValPogallo and the A54 that from Mergozzo climbs the summit of Monte Faiè

places.name: P07b - bivio A54 in località La Croce (Ompio) - Corte Buè

hints.description: Very popular and fastest way to reach Corte Buè da Ompio (Ruspesso locality) where the carriage road arrives. A path on the mountain side in a slight descent that runs through lush beech trees

hints.description: The cows reached the pastures of Orfalecchio and Rodugno starting from Rovegro following this historic road. Today it is partially included in the Riserva naturale integrata del Pedum and therefore the access is forbidden in that section

hints.from: San Benigno Canavese, Abbazia di Fruttuaria

hints.to: Bivio 132-132A, presso località Ghe di Castellamonte

hints.description: From Orfalecchio with steep climb to Alpe Rodugno and then on mountain side below the ridge of the Corni di Nibbio you reach the Bocchetta di Sautir
From Val Pogallo to Val Cannobina, crossing the ridge where the Bove path runs. This was also the route of the partisans fleeing to Switzerland during the German-Fascist raid of 1944

places.name: A52b - da Vercio a Alpe Ruspesso (Ompio)

hints.description: Short path on the mountain side which links Vercio to Ompio

places.name: P08 - Cicogna -Tregugno - la Soliva - Pian Cavallone

hints.description: A challenging path for complexity, development and difficulty, the path from la Soliva to the Forcola Saddle is on steep meadows and You crosse a valley with vertical rocky walls supported by the chains
hints.to: bivio R03 presso Colle della Forcola

places.name: SENTIERO BOVE - 1A TAPPA da Cicogna a Pian Cavallone

hints.description: Tough route for steep slopes to go up, but no technical difficulty, even marks, albeit sometimes distant, are present throughout the path and the trace is always visible

hints.description: The Strette del Casè range from the Bocchetta di Campo to the Prati di Ghina. Here we continue with a challenging ridge's path to Cima Sasso. From the Prati di Ghina you can reach Pogallo with the easiest route to Cavrua

places.name: X07SN - Strette del Casè via Cima Sasso da Sud a Nord

hints.description: It is less tiring and simpler to travel the Strette from North to South: see X07NS, here we present the route from South to North, from Cima Sasso to Bocchetta di Campo. We refer to the X07NS path for the information common to both

hints.description: The route winds along an ancient paved mule track, and features writings and drawings made by professional stonemasons at the time of construction commissioned by the patron Federico Rosazza in 1876.

places.name: SENTIERO BOVE - 4A TAPPA da Bivacco Lidesh a Bivacco Scaredi

hints.description: One of the most challenging stages of the Bove trail, the ascent to the Torrione on the Passo delle Crocette side is mountaineering and facilitated by chains, the ascent on the Bocchetta di Terza side is all on a trail with very exposed sections

hints.description: Panoramic path along the ridge that from Pian Cavallone leads first to Pizzo Marona, then to Monte Zeda from which you descend the North ridge reserved for expert hikers and finally to the Alpe Forna' bivouac under the north face of Zeda

From Malesco to Fondo li Gabbi in Val Loana, partially following the road and then for mule track at Alpe Scaredi gate of the Val Grande, then with easy path, in the high meadows, to the Bocchetta di Cortechiuso

places.name: P17 - Bivio M14 presso Cima della Laurasca - Rifugio Bta di Campo

hints.description: Path access to the Rifugio Bocchetta Campo and part of the BOVE trail. It winds on the north side of the Cima della Laurasca and then on the ridge between Val Pogallo and Valle Aperta
hints.from: Bivio M14 presso Cima della Laurasca

Beautiful walk through larch trees until Pian du Scricc then climb up to Pian Sass Mor, a steep rampart precedes the Valtendra Pass, a long traverse up to the Scatta d'Orogna, the flat Val Buscagna and a last steep descent leads to the Devero
Sentiero Italia - Tappa E56

Very steep path that from Suna climbs to the Chiesetta del Pellegrino, historically followed by a Christian worship procession very popular among the Suna population
Mountain side path on the Monterosso that from Suna climbs to Cavandone among chestnut woods and with views over the Borromeo Gulf

places.name: P01d - Cavandone - bivio Via al Monterosso

hints.description: An easy walk almost flat in the woods of Monterosso. Pay attention to mountain bikes
A magnificent panoramic path with breathtaking views of the ridges of the BOVE trail, elementary but tiring to the Alpe Busarasca, the long final crest is reserved for hikers specially experienced

hints.from: Bivio verso base parete sud Cima Battaglia (835)

places.name: P14NS - Cima Marsicce: la cresta in discesa fino al prato alla base

hints.description: The crest of the Cima Marsicce described downhill with the photos and the trail drawn on the photo, destined for hikers specially experienced. We refer to the path P14 described as uphill for the part from Alpe Busarasca to Pogallo

places.name: Alpe Varola - Fontan Gemelle - Corte Morgin

hints.description: Similar to its lower twin P06a but more tiring and hard to find because unmarked. To make a ring it is advisable to follow it on the way and return to P06a
Path for lovers of solitude in the beech woods of the Val Pobbie. Corte Morgin at the confluence of three rivers is a pleasant surprise on a sunny coast still rich in meadows.

places.name: P06 - Cicogna - Varola - Curgei - Pizzo Pernice

hints.description: Tough route for steep slopes to go up, but no technical difficulty, even marks, albeit sometimes distant, are present throughout the path and the trace is always visible
Panoramic ridge path between Val Pogallo and Val Grande, easy (T) until the Casa dell'Alpino, some little difficulty the final climb to the top (E)

places.name: SENTIERO BOVE - ALTERNATIVA da Strette del Casè a Cicogna via Cavrua

hints.description: From the Prati di Ghina (Strette del Casè) to the Alpe Cavrua and Pogallo as far as Cicogna, this is an easier route than the overcoming of Cima Sasso, but the path search difficulties are superior

places.name: X7NS - Strette del Casè via Cima Sasso da Nord a Sud

hints.description: The Strette del Casè range from the Bocchetta di Campo to the Prati di Ghina. Here we continue with a challenging ridge's path to Cima Sasso. From the Prati di Ghina you can reach Pogallo with the easiest route to Cavrua

places.name: A56 - Mergozzo - Sentiero Azzurro - Mont'Orfano vetta

hints.description: The A56 and A58 trails with Mont'Orfano ring, rich in historical points of interest: the granite quarries and military works of the Cadorna Line, and landscaping with 360 views over Lake Maggiore and Orta, and the peaks of the Val Grande to the Mottarone

With this path you can take a ring from Cicogna to the Casa dell'Alpino (P11) then to the alpi Leciurt, Braco and Caslù to Pogallo (P13) and return to Cicogna on the P00 classic route. Ring not recommended in the opposite direction
A comfortable well-trained and well-kept mule tracker in the lower Val Grande. Almost flat the first part, then a steep but short climb up to Nolezzo

The Filo di Nolezzo is worthy of its name: a perfect ridge line, aerial from beginning to end, extremely panoramic and never really difficult, even if there are some very exposed and treacherous sections, especially in autumn for the leaves

hints.from: Bivio 465-466 in borgata Vauda di Rocca
hints.to: Bivio 418-466 presso borgata San Pietro di Corio

hints.description: Short and easy path along one of the streets Cadorna, defense lines built in the 1915-18 war, with well-preserved trenches and casemates
hints.to: Fine percorso con piazzola e bandiera

places.name: Sentiero del Parco delle Alpi Liguri - Valle Arroscia e Giara di Rezzo

hints.description: Short and steep path, very scenic, which leads from the parking of Alpe Ruspesso to the top of Monte Faiè

places.name: R16 Sacro Monte SS.Trinità di Ghiffa - Pollino

hints.description: Route between the Sacro Monte SS. Trinità, World Heritage of Humanity, and Pollino: inside broad-leaved woods, Special Nature Reserve, at times steep pass by the Sabbia Rossa Chapel and the Streghe little lake. Views on Lake Maggiore.
hints.from: Sacro Monte S.S.Trinità di Ghiffa (diramazione R30 - R30e) (m 375)

places.name: R16a Diramazione R16 Sacro Monte di Ghiffa - Diramazione R16 Laghetto delle Streghe (Pollino)

hints.description: Direct path from Sacro Monte SS Trinità to Pollino (Witches pond) alternative to R16. From the ruins of the Cappella di Mezzo recommended for expert hikers, mostly steep, some steps on small rocks and exposed sections in the upper part.
hints.from: Diramazione R16 Sacro Monte di Ghiffa (m 425)

hints.description: From Gonte to Manegra via Alpe Casola. Start between inhabited hamlets, then trail with some steep parts, from A.Casola forest road. From Cappella S.Maria to A.Casola poor maintenance; difficult passage in small valley ~780 m under A.Casola.

places.name: R24b Cappella S.Maria bivio R24 - Manegra bivio R10

hints.description: Direct path to Alpe Manegra starting from the Cappella di S. Maria at the crossroad with R24 for Alpe Casola. Path marked by white paint sometimes faded and difficult to identify.
hints.from: Cappella S.Maria sopra Mozzola, bivio R24 (m 520)

places.name: R30b Gonte SS34 - Gonte diramazione R30

hints.description: From the SS34 of Lago Maggiore with a short path you go up to Gonte, you pass near the Parish Church of S. Pietro and you reach the R30 path "Via delle Genti".
From Travallino, hamlet of Oggebbio, P.zza chiesa Sant'Antonio, through hamlets Piazza, Dumera, Casere Comino, up to Luera, crossroads with R10, R12, R14, R18.

places.name: R30c Pieggio porto - Travallino diramazione R30

hints.description: From Pieggio (port of Oggebbio), climb up passing from the P.zza chiesa di S. Rocco to reach Travallino (Oggebbio), P.zza chiesa di Sant'Antonio, intersection with the routes R30 and R22.
The route starts from Camogno, at the junction with the provincial road where passes the Via delle Genti (R30) and ends at Luera, crossroads with the routes R10, R12, R14, R22.

places.name: R02 Verbania Intra bivio R30 Via Selasca - Arizzano - Albagnano - Premeno - Pizzo d'Omo

hints.description: From Verbania Intra crossroads R30 Via Selasca through Pastura, Antoliva, Cresseglio, Cissano, Arizzano, Albagnano, then the holiday resorts Premeno and Pian di Sole, to climb to Pizzo d'Omo (m 1056) and finish at the crossroads of the path R02,R02A,R10.
hints.from: Verbania Intra bivio R30 Via Selasca (m 210)

places.name: R04 Verbania Intra - Zoverallo - San Martino - Bèe - Monte Cimolo - Pian Nava

hints.description: From Verbania Intra P.za Ranzoni (crossroads R30) through Zoverallo, San Martino, Bèe, to climb to Monte Cimolo (m 950) and walk down at Pian Nava (crossroads R06, R08).
hints.from: Verbania Intra P.za Ranzoni, bivio R30 (m 200)

places.name: R00 Verbania Intra P.le Flaim - Trobaso - Cambiasca - Caprezzo - Intragna - Aurano

hints.description: From Verbania Intra P.le Flaim through Trobaso,Cambiasca,Caprezzo,Intragna to Aurano, crossroad with R8,R14,R15. Long path that enters the uncontaminated Valle Intrasca of the San Giovanni torrent, adjoining the Val Grande National Park.

places.name: R01 Verbania Trobaso - Unchio - Motto di Unchio - Pian di Les - Cossogno

hints.description: From Verbania Trobaso, Via al Cotonificio, you reach the cycle road on the left side of the San Bernardino river, go up to Unchio and the Oratory of Motto di Unchio, then through a peat bog and Pian di Les, you reach Cossogno (crossroads P00).
hints.from: Trobaso, bivio R00 Via al Cotonificio (m 240)
hints.to: Cossogno, bivio P00 Via San Martino (m 365)

hints.description: From Premeno,crossroad R02,in direction of Le Australie,go up the provincial road to Pollino,after about 300 m deviate into V.Manegra. A path on the left leads to Sasso Mezzano with a wonderful view of Lago Maggiore,then to the crossroad with R10.
hints.to: Nord Pizzo d'Omo bivio percorso R10 (m 920)

places.name: R10 Sacro Monte S.S.Trinità di Ghiffa - Pollino - Piancavallo - Colle - Passo Folungo

hints.description: Long route from the Sacro Monte SS.Trinità di Ghiffa,Sanctuary and Unesco Heritage,to Passo Folungo,between Valle Intrasca and Cannobina,through Caronio,Pollino,Luera,Manegra, Piancavallo,crossroads for Cima Morissolo,Colle,Pian d'Arla and Pian Puzz.
hints.from: Sacro Monte SS. Trinità di Ghiffa, bivio R30 (m 392)
hints.to: Passo Folungo, bivio R11, R19, R20, S15 (m 1369)

hints.description: The route starts from Aurano, crosses some little valleys to reach the Alpe Erbia and then, with a flat path, reaches Luera, crossroads the R10, R12, R18, R22 routes.

places.name: R03 Cambiasca - Pian Cavallone - Pizzo Marona - Monte Zeda

hints.description: Route of great landscape interest that goes from Cambiasca to Monte Zeda passing from the peak of Pizzo Marona; it crosses Miazzina,Alpe Pala,Cappella Fina,Pian Cavallone,Colle Forcola,Passo del Diavolo,Pizzo Marona. Exposed stretch with chains.

places.name: R07 Intragna - Cappella del Pian Cavallone

hints.description: In very open environment between Intragna and the Rifugio Pian Cavallone CAI Verbano,through Cambiesso and Sunfaì along the route of the Valle Intrasca Marathon.Continuing on R03,near the ruined of ex-hotel,there is the winter bivouac always open.
hints.to: Cappella del Pian Cavallone - bivio R03 (m 1544)

places.name: R05 Caprezzo - Pian Cavallone bivio R07

hints.description: The route connects Caprezzo to the R07 crossroads just below the CAI refuge at Pian Cavallone. From Caprezzo, climbing to the Mon Rous and Ad Vel pastures, you reach Cappella Porta, then, in a beech and fir wood, climb to the CAI Verbano refuge.

places.name: R03a Cappella Fina bivio R03 - Bivio R05 tra Cappella Porta e Cornala

hints.description: Connection route between Cappella Fina (crossroads R03) and crossroads with R05 Cappella Porta-Cornala. Useful for the R03-R05 ring route through Pian Cavallone. Some large part of the route on a wide dirt road and part on path. Some small stream fords.
hints.to: Bivio R05 tra Cappella Porta e Cornala (m 1200)

places.name: R30 'Via delle Genti': tratto Cannero - Oggebbio - Sacro Monte SS.Trinità di Ghiffa - Verbania Intra

hints.description: Historic "Via delle Genti". Route from Cannero to Intra through the numerous hamlets of Oggebbio. Superb panoramic view of Lake Maggiore in a succession of frescoed oratories and chapels. Sacro Monte SS.Trinità di Ghiffa, Sanctuary and Unesco Heritage.
Route that connects Fodrasca, crossroad with R20, to Colle, crossroad with R10, passing near the old mountain huts of fhe pastures Bellino, Scesolo and Cadelina.

From the junction with R20 to Fudrasca, towards Piazza, near the Oratory of Sant'Eurosia of the XVII century (crossroad S11), then towards Colle Pianbello (crossroad S09) to finish on Mount Pianbello to the R38. Panoramic views of Lake Maggiore.

From Trarego, at the crossroads with the R20, towards the Büsé and Lemanno mountain pastures; cross the SP92 Trarego - Colle and pass near to Cima Ologno to reach Monte Pianbello. Panoramic route overlooking Lake Maggiore.

From Viggiona,at the crossroad with R46,towards Piazza del Pozzo and then to Monte Carza,insertion R40. Just before the top there is the Stella del Lago Maggiore Chapel,a wonderful view of Lake Maggiore. Remains of military posts of the First World War.

The route starts from Aurano, descends to the stream of Val Luisina crossing the provincial road several times; it climbs to Esio with a path immersed in broadleaf forest and first on the road and then on a comfortable mule track comes to Premeno.

places.name: R20 Cannero - Oggiogno - Trarego - Cima l'Alpe - Monte Spalavera - Pian Puzz - Archia - Passo Folungo - Monte Zeda

hints.description: Route of great historical and landscape interest that goes from Cannero to Monte Zeda passing through Oggiogno, Trarego, Cima l'Alpe, Monte Spalavera slope north, Pian Puzz, Archia; from Passo Folungo to Pian Vadà along the Cadorna Road.

places.name: R19 Passo Folungo - Monte Vadà - Bivio R20 al Pian Vadà

hints.description: Direct route from Passo Folungo to Pian Vadà passing from the summit of M.Vadà. The Pian Vadà refuge can be reached with a connection to the last bend of the Strada Cadorna. Path with steep sections facilitated by some chains, but only in the first part.
hints.from: Passo Folungo, R10 R11 R20 S15 (m 1369)

hints.description: The route, in the woods on the hillside, starts from the square of Esio on a paved road, then continues on a gravel road and on a path, then on a cart track it reach Luera.

places.name: P01v - Sentiero della Bergamina variante turistica

hints.description: Variant to route P01c which avoids on the road an uncomfortable stretch of the path

places.name: P30 - Alpe in La Piana - Alpe Scaredi

hints.description: One of the pats of the classic North South crossing of the wild Valgrande for a route easy to follow and maintained by the Ente Parco Valgrande

places.name: Dal Rio Valgrande a Corte Buè

hints.description: Short and very steep connection between the Val Grande path along the river and Corte Buè

places.name: R01a - Bivio R01 Cappella Madonna di Re - Bivio P00 in piazza a Santino

hints.from: Bivio R01 C.la Madonna di Re
hints.to: Bivio P00 in piazza a Santino

hints.description: Short connection between the R03 and P02 paths and the quickest access to the large summer pasture of Runchio (Rugno)

places.name: A58 - Mergozzo - Linea Cadorna - Mont'Orfano vetta

hints.description: The A56 and A58 trails with Mont'Orfano ring, rich in historical points of interest: the granite quarries and military works of the Cadorna Line, and landscaping with 360 views over Lake Maggiore and Orta, and the peaks of the Val Grande to the Mottarone

places.name: P02c - Memoriale Alpini - Alpe della Chiesa

hints.description: Relaxing almost flat walk between the R03 and P02 paths, a very visible and easily walkable route
hints.to: bivio P02 sopra Alpe della Chiesa

places.name: P02d - Cappella Fina - bivio P02 sotto Monte Todun

hints.description: Relaxing almost flat walk between the R03 and P02 paths, a very visible and easily walkable route

From the boat dock of Cannero you pass alongside the marina and the town beach. Go along the last part of the lakefront, go up to the SS 34, cross it and enter the mule track to Cassino up to the intersection with R30.

places.name: Alpe Baserga - Alpe Velina di Sopra

hints.description: Short path between the two Alpeggi di Velina, the trail starts from Baserga not far from Velina Sotto

places.name: C05d - collegamento sentieri C01 e C05

hints.description: Link between the paths C01 and C05 allows, rising from Villadossola or Pallanzeno, to reach the S. Giacomo alp without passing the Basciumo alp

Route from Villadossola, through the fractions of Piaggio Sopra and Gaggitti, going up, passing through the pastures of Corticcio, Basciumo Sotto and Sopra, reaches the Baldana alp. From here, joning with the path C05, you reach the S. Giacomo alp.

places.name: P03 - Oratorio di Santino - bivio A54 nei pressi Cappella di Erfo

hints.description: Short path that reaches the Cappella di Erfo keeping in the woods below the road
hints.to: Bivio A54 sotto Cappella di Erfo

hints.description: Route from Pallanzeno to Alpe Corticcio passing from the Enel Basin from where you have a nice view of the lower Ossola Valley. From Alpe Corticcio join the path C01 for Basciumo and S. Giacomo

places.name: D12 - S. Bernardo - Monte del Dente

hints.description: The route climbs from S. Bernardo the ridge first wooded, then meadow with views on both sides on two lakes, reaching Verrosso Peak

places.name: M19 - Alpe Verzasca - Pioda di Crana

hints.description: Well marked path. First part in the forest path not too obvious, then trail ridge also exposed. Steep slopes; last stretch very exposed to avoid in case of rain
Well marked trail with several passages next to the road, does not present difficulties
